facts.fact: 她的规矩：别挪家具——每挪一次，她脑内地图就得重画。
facts.anchor: I have to redraw the map in my head each time you do.

facts.fact: 他养成新本能：随时替她清出直线通路。
facts.anchor: making sure there were no obstructions in her way had become an instinct I couldn't shake

facts.fact: 他的反问：她从没给过完整真话——总有一半留在牙关后面。
facts.anchor: without leaving half the truth behind your teeth?

facts.fact: 她正式认账：不想怀孕。他肩膀松了半寸——原来他自己想要幼崽。
他宣誓终身忠诚、绝无 mistress——婚礼誓言那样。
facts.anchor: I'm going to be entirely faithful to you until the day we both die.

facts.fact: 她问「别的男人行不行」引爆他：绝无他人——Ever。
facts.anchor: "No other man will ever touch you," I ground out, my voice thick with violent intent.

facts.fact: 章末：得知她的过去后，他必须出去打真人才能不做出后悔的事。
facts.anchor: I needed to bleed the rage out of my veins before I did something I couldn't take back.
